sessions.title: First sales hire or keep selling
sessions.prompt: I'm a solo founder of a B2B SaaS at $25k MRR growing 5% a month. I do every sales call myself (about 20 hours a week) and I'm burning out. Should I hire a full-time account executive at $120k base, hire a part-time commission-only closer, or keep selling myself for six more months? I have $150k in the bank.

sessions.title: Raise coaching price to $3,500
sessions.prompt: I run a coaching business doing $30k a month with 15 active clients at $2,000 each. I want to raise the price to $3,500. Options: raise for everyone now, raise for new clients only, or keep $2,000. Close rate is about 50% on sales calls. I am leaning toward raising for everyone because I am underpaid.
